author: Charles H. Spurgeon
title_en: Faith: What It Is and What It Leads To
title_tet: Fiar: Saida Mak Nia Essénsia no Nia Rezultadu sira
subtitle_en: "He that believeth on him is not condemned" (John 3:18)
subtitle_tet: "Ema ne'ebé fiar ba Nia la hetan kondenasaun" (João 3:18)

cards.section_heading_en: Introduction - "He that believeth on him is not condemned"
cards.section_heading_tet: Introdusaun - "Ema ne'ebé fiar ba Nia la hetan kondenasaun"
cards.scripture_en: "He that believeth on him is not condemned." — John 3:18
cards.scripture_tet: "Ema ne'ebé fiar ba Nia la hetan kondenasaun." — João 3:18
cards.body_en: The way of salvation is stated in Scripture in the very plainest terms, and yet, perhaps, there is no truth about which more errors have been uttered, than concerning the faith which saves the soul. Well has it been proved by experience, that all doctrines of Christ are mysterious—mysterious, not so much in themselves, but because they are hid to them that are lost, in whom the god of this world hath blinded their eyes. So plain is Scripture, that one would have said, "He that runs may read;" but so dim is man's eye, and so marred is his understanding, that the very simplest truth of Scripture he distorts and misrepresents. While faith is the simplest thing in all the world, yet it is one of the most difficult upon which to write; because from its very importance, our soul begins to tremble while speaking of it, and then we are not able to describe it so clearly as we would.
cards.body_tet: Dalan salvasaun nian hakerek iha Eskritura ho liafuan ne'ebé simples no klaru liu, maibé karik laiha lia-loos seluk ne'ebé mosu ho sala barak liu fali kona-ba fiar ne'ebé salva klamar. Esperiénsia hatudu ona ho klaru katak doutrina Kristu nian hotu mak misteriózu—misteriózu la'ós iha sira-nia aan rasik, maibé tanba subar hela ba sira ne'ebé lakon, ne'ebé maromak mundu ida-ne'e nian halo nakukun sira-nia matan. Eskritura klaru tebes to'o ema bele dehan, "Ema ne'ebé halai mós bele lee"; maibé ema nia matan nakukun no ninia komprensaun aat, hodi halo nia distorse no troka lia-loos Eskritura nian ne'ebé simples liu. Maski fiar mak buat simples liu iha mundu tomak, ida-ne'e mak tópiku ida ne'ebé susar liu atu hakerek; tanba ho nia importánsia boot, ita-nia klamar hahú nakdedar bainhira ko'alia kona-ba ida-ne'e, no ita la bele esplika ho klaru hanesan ita hakarak.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Though the way of salvation and faith are plain in Scripture, human blindness causes widespread error, making faith both simple and weighty to explain.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Maski dalan salvasaun no fiar klaru iha Eskritura, matan-delek umana hamosu sala barak, hodi halo fiar sai simples maibé todan tebes atu esplika.

cards.section_heading_en: 1. The Object of Faith; or, To What Faith Looks
cards.section_heading_tet: 1. Objetu Fiar nian; ka Saida Mak Fiar Hateke Ba
cards.scripture_en: "For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life" (John 3:16).
cards.scripture_tet: "Tanba Maromak hadomi tebes mundu to'o fó Ninia Oan-Mane mesak, atu ema hotu ne'ebé fiar iha Nia la bele lakon, maibé hetan moris rohan-laek" (João 3:16).
cards.body_en: What is to be the object of my hope, belief, and confidence? The reply is simple. The object of Faith to a sinner is Christ Jesus. How many make a mistake about this and think that they are to believe on God the Father! Now, belief in God is an after result of faith in Jesus. We come to believe in the eternal love of the Father as the result of trusting the precious blood of the Son. Some, too, make the mistake of looking to the work of God the Holy Spirit. They look within to see if they have certain feelings, yet for the particular mercy of justification and pardon the blood of the Mediator is the only plea. Learn to look on Christ as being in God's sight as though he were the sinner. "In him was no sin." He was "the just," but he suffered for the unjust. He was the righteous, but he stood in the place of the unrighteous; and all that the unrighteous ought to have endured, Christ has endured once for all, and put away their sins forever by the sacrifice of himself.
cards.body_tet: Saida mak tenke sai objetu ba ha'u-nia esperansa, fiar no konfiansa? Resposta simples de'it. Objetu Fiar nian ba ema sala-na'in mak Kristu Jesus. Ema barak halo sala kona-ba ida-ne'e no hanoin katak sira tenke fiar ba Maromak Aman! Maibé fiar ba Maromak mak rezultadu ne'ebé tuir mai husi fiar ba Jesus. Ita mai fiar ba Aman nia domin rohan-laek nu'udar rezultadu husi fiar ba Oan nia raan folin-boot. Ema balun mós halo sala hodi hateke ba servisu Maromak Espíritu Santu nian. Sira hateke ba laran atu haree se sira iha sentimentu balun, maibé ba laran-sadia espesiál kona-ba justifikasaun no perdaun, Mediadór nia raan mak razaun mesak. Aprende atu hateke ba Kristu iha Maromak nia oin hanesan Nia mak ema sala-na'in. "Iha Nia laiha sala." Nia mak "ema loos", maibé Nia terus ba ema ne'ebé la loos. Nia mak ema justu, maibé Nia hamriik iha ema ne'ebé la justu nia fatin; no terus hotu ne'ebé ema la justu tenke tahan, Kristu tahan ona dala ida de'it, no hasai tiha sira-nia sala ba nafatin liuhosi sakrifísiu Nia aan rasik.
cards.key_takeaway_en: The saving object of faith is Jesus Christ and His finished substitutionary sacrifice—not inward feelings or human merit.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Objetu salvasaun nian husi fiar mak Jesus Kristu no Ninia sakrifísiu substitusaun ne'ebé kompletu ona—la'ós sentimentu laran nian ka méritu umana.

cards.section_heading_en: 2. The Reason of Faith; or, Why Doth Any Man Believe?
cards.section_heading_tet: 2. Kauza Fiar nian; ka Tanbasá Mak Ema Ruma Fiar?
cards.scripture_en: "No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him" (John 6:44).
cards.scripture_tet: "Laiha ema ida bele mai Ha'u, se la'ós Aman ne'ebé haruka Ha'u mak dada nia" (João 6:44).
cards.body_en: "Faith cometh by hearing." Granted, but do not all men hear, and do not many still remain unbelieving? How, then, doth any man come by his faith? To his own experience his faith comes as the result of a sense of need. He feels himself needing a Savior; he finds Christ to be just such a Savior as he wants, and therefore because he cannot help himself, he believes in Jesus. Where does that man get his sense of need? The reply is, this is the gift of God; this is the work of the Spirit. No man comes to Christ except the Spirit draw him. The reason of faith, or why men believe, is God's electing love working through the Spirit by a sense of need, and so bringing them to Christ Jesus.
cards.body_tet: "Fiar mai husi rona." Loos duni, maibé la'ós ema hotu rona, no barak nafatin la fiar? Entaun, oinsá mak ema ruma hetan fiar? Tuir ninia esperiénsia rasik, fiar mai nu'udar rezultadu husi sente nesesidade. Nia sente katak nia presiza Salvador ida; nia hetan katak Kristu mak Salvador ne'ebé nia presiza duni, no tanba ne'e, tanba nia la bele ajuda aan rasik, nia fiar ba Jesus. Husi ne'ebé mak ema ne'e hetan sentidu nesesidade ne'e? Resposta mak, ida-ne'e prezente Maromak nian; ida-ne'e servisu Espíritu nian. Laiha ema ida mai Kristu se la'ós Espíritu mak dada nia. Kauza fiar nian, ka tanbasá ema fiar, mak Maromak nia domin hili nian ne'ebé serbisu liuhosi Espíritu ho sentidu nesesidade, hodi lori sira ba Kristu Jesus.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Men come to believe because God's electing love works through the Spirit to awaken a deep sense of need for Christ.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Ema fiar tanba Maromak nia domin hili nian serbisu liuhosi Espíritu atu fanu sentidu nesesidade kle'an ba Kristu.

cards.section_heading_en: 3. The Ground of the Sinner's Faith
cards.scripture_en: "This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners" (1 Tim 1:15).
cards.scripture_tet: "Liafuan ida-ne'e laran-metin, no merese atu simu tomak, katak Kristu Jesus mai iha mundu atu salva ema sala-na'in" (1 Timóteo 1:15).
cards.body_en: The ground on which a man comes to Jesus, is not as a sensible sinner, but as a sinner, and nothing but a sinner. He will not come unless he is awakened; but when he comes, he does not say, "Lord, I come to thee because I am an awakened sinner, save me." But he says, "Lord, I am a sinner, save me." Not his awakening, but his sinnership is the method and plan upon which he dares to come. Sinners do feel these things before they come, but they do not come on the ground of having felt it; they come on the ground of being sinners, and on no other ground whatever. The gate of mercy is opened, and over the door it is written, "This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners."
cards.body_tet: Fundasaun ne'ebé ema ida uza atu mai Jesus la'ós nu'udar ema sala-na'in ne'ebé sente ona, maibé nu'udar ema sala-na'in, no la'ós buat seluk. Nia la mai se nia la fanu; maibé bainhira nia mai, nia la dehan, "Na'i, ha'u mai Ita-Boot tanba ha'u ema sala-na'in ne'ebé fanu ona, salva ha'u." Maibé nia dehan, "Na'i, ha'u ema sala-na'in, salva ha'u." La'ós ninia fanu an, maibé ninia kondisaun sala-na'in mak métodu no planu ne'ebé nia uza atu brani mai. Ema sala-na'in sente buat sira-ne'e antes sira mai, maibé sira la mai tanba sente ona; sira mai tanba sira ema sala-na'in, no la iha fundasaun seluk. Odamatan laran-sadia nian nakloke, no iha odamatan leten hakerek, "Liafuan ida-ne'e laran-metin, no merese atu simu tomak, katak Kristu Jesus mai iha mundu atu salva ema sala-na'in."
cards.key_takeaway_en: A sinner comes to Christ on the sole ground of being a sinner in need of mercy, never on personal worthiness or feelings.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Ema sala-na'in mai Kristu ho fundasaun mesak katak nia ema sala-na'in ne'ebé presiza laran-sadia, nunka ho méritu ka sentimentu rasik.

cards.section_heading_en: 4. The Warrant of Faith; or, Why It Dares to Trust
cards.section_heading_tet: 4. Garantia Fiar nian; ka Tanbasá Mak Fiar Brani Konfia
cards.scripture_en: "Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved" (Acts 16:31).
cards.scripture_tet: "Fiar ba Na'i Jesus Kristu, no ó sei hetan salvasaun" (Apóstolu sira-nia Hahalok 16:31).
cards.body_en: What is a man's warrant then for believing in Christ? Here it is. Christ tells him to do it, that is his warrant. Christ's word is the warrant of the sinner for believing in Christ—not what he feels nor what he is, nor what he is not, but that Christ has told him to do it. The Gospel runs thus: "Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ and thou shalt be saved. He that believeth not shall be damned." Faith in Christ then is a commanded duty as well as a blessed privilege. On the ground that God commands me to believe, I have a right to believe, be I who I may. The gospel is sent to every creature. You may believe Christ because he tells you to do so.
cards.body_tet: Saida mak garantia ema ida nian atu fiar ba Kristu? Mak ida-ne'e. Kristu haruka nia atu halo ida-ne'e, ne'e mak nia garantia. Kristu nia liafuan mak garantia ema sala-na'in nian atu fiar ba Kristu—la'ós buat ne'ebé nia sente ka buat ne'ebé nia mak saida, ka la'ós saida, maibé tanba Kristu haruka ona nia atu halo ida-ne'e. Evanjellu dehan nune'e: "Fiar ba Na'i Jesus Kristu no ó sei hetan salvasaun. Ema ne'ebé la fiar sei hetan kondenasaun." Fiar ba Kristu mak devér ne'ebé haruka mós no priviléjiu bensaun nian. Tanba Maromak haruka ha'u atu fiar, ha'u iha direitu atu fiar, maski ha'u sé de'it. Evanjellu haruka ba kriatura hotu-hotu. Ó bele fiar Kristu tanba Nia haruka ó atu halo nune'e.
cards.key_takeaway_en: The sinner's warrant to trust Christ is Christ's own gospel command and promise—a duty and privilege for all.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Garantia ema sala-na'in nian atu fiar Kristu mak Kristu nia mandamentu no promesa evanjellu nian rasik—devér no priviléjiu ba ema hotu.

cards.section_heading_en: 5. The Result of Faith; or, How It Speeds
cards.section_heading_tet: 5. Rezultadu Fiar nian; ka Oinsá Mak Fiar La'o Lalais
cards.scripture_en: "And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited" (Lev 16:22).
cards.scripture_tet: "No bibi-timur ne'e sei lori sira-nia sala hotu ba rai ne'ebé ema la hela ba" (Levitiku 16:22).
cards.body_en: The moment a man puts his trust in Christ, he is freed from all condemnation—past, present, and to come; and from that day he stands in God's sight as though he were without spot or wrinkle, or any such thing. Scripture says the scapegoat carried away the sin; there was none left on the people when the scapegoat had taken away the sin. And so, when by faith we put our hand upon the head of Christ, does Christ take away our sin, or does he not? As soon as a man believeth in Christ Jesus, his sins are gone from him, and gone away forever. They are blotted out now. If thou believest in Christ, thou art no more in the sight of God a sinner; thou art accepted as though thou wert perfect.
cards.body_tet: Iha momentu ne'ebé ema ida tau konfiansa iha Kristu, nia livre husi kondenasaun hotu—liu ona, agora no sei mai; no husi loron ne'e nia hamriik iha Maromak nia oin hanesan la iha pontu ka ruga, ka buat ruma hanesan ne'e. Eskritura dehan bibi-timur espiatóriu lori tiha sala; la iha buat ida hela ba povu bainhira bibi-timur ne'e foti tiha sala. Nune'e mós, bainhira liuhosi fiar ita tau ita-nia liman iha Kristu nia ulun, Kristu foti tiha ita-nia sala ka lae? Bainhira ema ida fiar iha Jesus Kristu, ninia sala sai tiha husi nia, no sai tiha ba nafatin. Sira hamoos tiha ona agora. Se ó fiar iha Kristu, ó la'ós ona ema sala-na'in iha Maromak nia oin; ó hetan simu hanesan ó perfeitu.
cards.key_takeaway_en: The moment a sinner believes in Christ, all sin is taken away as by the scapegoat, and the believer stands accepted before God.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Iha momentu ne'ebé ema sala-na'in fiar iha Kristu, sala hotu foti tiha hanesan bibi-timur espiatóriu, no fiar-na'in hetan simu iha Maromak nia oin.

cards.section_heading_en: 6. Satisfactory Declaration Concerning Those Who Have Faith
cards.section_heading_tet: 6. Deklarasaun Kbiit-Nain Kona-Ba Sira Ne'ebé Iha Fiar
cards.scripture_en: "He that believeth on him is not condemned" (John 3:18).
cards.scripture_tet: "Ema ne'ebé fiar ba Nia la hetan kondenasaun" (João 3:18).
cards.body_en: In our courts of law, a verdict of "not guilty" amounts to an acquittal, and the prisoner is immediately discharged. So is it in the language of the gospel; a sentence of "not condemned" implies the justification of the sinner. It means that the believer in Christ receives now a present justification. All these promises go to show that the justification which Christ gives to our faith is a continual one, which will last as long as we shall live. And, remember, it will last in eternity as well as in time. This justification is complete. "He that believeth on him is not condemned;" that is to say not in any measure or in any degree.
cards.body_tet: Iha ita-nia tribunál sira, desizaun "la sala" signifika absolvisaun, no prizioneiru sai kedas livre. Nune'e mós iha liafuan evanjellu nian; fraze "la hetan kondenasaun" hatudu justifikasaun ema sala-na'in nian. Ida-ne'e signifika katak fiar-na'in iha Kristu simu agora justifikasaun prezente ida. Promesa sira-ne'e hotu hatudu katak justifikasaun ne'ebé Kristu fó ba ita-nia fiar mak ida ne'ebé kontinua, ne'ebé sei dura to'o ita moris. No hanoin, ida-ne'e sei dura iha eternidade no mós iha tempu. Justifikasaun ida-ne'e kompletu. "Ema ne'ebé fiar ba Nia la hetan kondenasaun"; katak la'ós iha medida ka grau ruma.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Justification in Christ is immediate, continual into eternity, and complete without any remaining condemnation.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Justifikasaun iha Kristu akontese kedas, kontinua to'o eternidade, no kompletu sein kondenasaun ruma hela.

cards.scripture_en: "That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth... might be found unto praise and honour and glory" (1 Pet 1:7).
cards.scripture_tet: "Atu prova ba imi-nia fiar, ne'ebé folin-boot liu fali osan-mean ne'ebé lakon... bele hetan lori ba louvór, onra no glória" (1 Pedro 1:7).
cards.body_en: Observe that although it is asserted "He that believeth is not condemned;" yet it is not said that he that believeth shall not have his faith exercised. Your faith will be exercised. An untried faith will be no faith at all. God never gave men faith without intending to try it. When your faith is exercised with trials, do not think you are brought into judgment for your sins. Though you fall into sins, you are not condemned for all—not by one of them, or by all of them put together, because your acceptance does not depend upon yourself, but upon the perfect righteousness of Christ.
cards.body_tet: Nota katak maski dehan "Ema ne'ebé fiar la hetan kondenasaun"; maibé la dehan katak ema ne'ebé fiar sei la hetan ezersísiu ba ninia fiar. Ó-nia fiar sei hetan ezersísiu. Fiar ne'ebé la hetan prova la'ós fiar ida. Maromak nunka fó fiar ba ema sein hakarak atu prova ida-ne'e. Bainhira ó-nia fiar hetan ezersísiu ho provasun sira, keta hanoin katak ó hetan julgamentu tanba ó-nia sala sira. Maski ó monu ba sala sira, ó la hetan kondenasaun ba sira hotu—la'ós tanba ida ka sira hotu hamutuk, tanba ó-nia simu la depende ba ó-nia aan rasik, maibé ba justisa perfeitu Kristu nian.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Trials test genuine faith without cancelling justification, which rests on Christ's perfect righteousness rather than shifting feelings or failings.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Provasun sira prova fiar loos sein halakon justifikasaun, ne'ebé harii iha justisa perfeitu Kristu nian no la'ós iha sentimentu ka fallansu sira.

cards.section_heading_tet: 8 & 9. Saida Mak Fiar Inklui no Esklui
cards.scripture_en: "I am black, but comely, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Solomon" (Song 1:5).
cards.scripture_tet: "Ha'u metan, maibé furak, oh oan-feto sira Jerusalém nian, hanesan tenda sira Kedar nian, hanesan kortina sira Salomão nian" (Kántiku dos Kántikus 1:5).
cards.body_en: From the moment when you believe in Christ, God ceases to look upon you as being guilty; for he never looks upon you apart from Christ. You are black as the tents of Kedar—that is yourself by nature; you are fair as the curtains of Solomon—that is yourself in Christ. What does it exclude? Well, I am sure it excludes boasting. "He that believeth is not condemned." Ah! if it said, "He that worketh is not condemned," then you and I might boast in any quantity. But when it says, "He that believeth"—why, there is no room for us to say half a word for old self. It ought to exclude doubts and fears. And this excludes sinning anymore. What! go and sin because I am forgiven? Go and live in iniquity because Jesus Christ took my guilt and suffered in my room and stead? Human nature is bad enough, but methinks this is the very worst state of human nature, when it tries to draw an argument for sin from the free grace of God. "I'm a poor sinner and nothing at all, But Jesus Christ is my all in all."
cards.body_tet: Husi momentu ne'ebé ó fiar iha Kristu, Maromak para hateke ba ó nu'udar ema ne'ebé sala; tanba Nia nunka hateke ba ó iha Kristu nia li'ur. Ó metan hanesan tenda sira Kedar nian—ne'e mak ó rasik tuir natureza; ó furak hanesan kortina sira Salomão nian—ne'e mak ó iha Kristu. Saida mak ida-ne'e esklui? Ha'u fiar katak ida-ne'e esklui gaba aan. "Ema ne'ebé fiar la hetan kondenasaun." Ai! Se dehan, "Ema ne'ebé serbisu la hetan kondenasaun", entaun ó no ha'u bele gaba aan ho barak. Maibé bainhira dehan, "Ema ne'ebé fiar"—la iha fatin ba ita atu ko'alia liafuan balun ba ita-nia aan tuan. Ida-ne'e tenke esklui dúvida no tauk sira. No ida-ne'e esklui halo sala tan. Saida! Ba halo sala tanba ha'u hetan perdaun ona? Ba moris iha maldade tanba Jesus Kristu foti tiha ha'u-nia sala no terus iha ha'u-nia fatin? Natureza umana aat ona, maibé ha'u hanoin ida-ne'e mak estadu aat liu husi natureza umana, bainhira buka razaun ba sala husi grasa livre Maromak nian. "Ha'u ema sala-na'in kiak no la iha buat ida, Maibé Jesus Kristu mak ha'u-nia buat hotu."
cards.key_takeaway_en: Faith in Christ excludes boasting, needless fear, and presumptuous sin, making Christ our all in all.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Fiar iha Kristu esklui gaba aan, tauk ne'ebé la presiza no sala ho atrevimentu, hodi halo Kristu sai ita-nia buat hotu.
